title: EPIC-166 daemon 真跑验证 — 防止假 PASS
description:
EPIC-168-F — 验证 EPIC-166 (Heartbeat Daemon + Quota-aware 调度 + Run History Event Ledger) 真跑有效. 防止假 PASS (跟 EPIC-069-D 5-Level Verify 1:1).

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-05 拍板 Phase 5 F — EPIC-166 实施完成但未真跑过 daemon. 跟 EPIC-069-D 5-Level Verify 一致, 必须真跑 60s 循环验证 6 子命令 (start/stop/status/should-run/next-transition/emit) + quota 6 层 + scheduler P0/P1/P2 + run-history 4 类 event append-only 真有效.

**任务**:
1. **daemon 真跑 60s 循环** — `heartbeat-daemon.sh start`, 60s 后 `status` 验证, `stop`
2. **quota 真测** — `quota.sh check --ticket-id EPIC-XXX --agent-id performer-X` 6 层 (L1-L6) + 3 状态 (eligible/throttled/paused)
3. **scheduler-hint 真测** — `scheduler-hint.sh next --priority P0/P1/P2` 看优先级顺序
4. **run-history 真测** — emit work + decision + accounting + evidence 4 类 event, query 验证
5. **append-only 真测** — 试图改写已写入行, 验证真 append-only
6. **state 持久化真验** — daemon stop 后 state/run-history.jsonl + quota-db.json 保留
7. **跟 EPIC-023-C 北极星 4 指标打通真验** — accounting event emit 后能算 mis_dispatch_binding_rate
8. **5-Level Verify L1-L5 跑实** (跟 EPIC-157~161 1:1)

**0 改 source code, 0 增 Rule, 0 增 immutable script** (纯 verification, 1 个 test script)

**跟 BE-14 关系**: 不冲突. 1 ticket 1 subagent 串行.
**跟 EPIC-054-A 关系**: 不冲突. worktree 隔离.
